title: Having the best time in Gander, Newfoundland- wanted to just give a q...
transcript: Okay, I'm officially halfway through my come from away themed trip to Gander, Newfoundland. So wanted to give you all a quick little update on everything that we have done so far cause it has been a jam packed two days. We flew into Gander yesterday morning and then waiting to pick us up at the airport was the mayor, Claude. Well, former mayor now, but he was mayor during 9 11 and is the one depicted in the musical. And it was so funny because we actually got to have lunch with him at the airport. But as we're walking to lunch, all of these people are stopping him and being like, hey, Claude, like literally every single person in this town knows him and he knows every single person in this town. And then we got to chat his ear off at lunch and ask all of the questions that we wanna ask about come from away. And I think the common theme across everyone that we've been able to meet who is depicted in the musical so far is they all love talking about it. They are just as kind and giving with their time as you would expect having seen the musical. Later that night we got screeched in, which is the ceremony where you kiss the fish. That was hosted by Brian, the real life Janice, who was gender swapped in the show. We found out that that character, Janice Mosher, is actually a combination Of two different people. So Janice was a newspaper reporter covering it for her newspaper, and it was actually her first day. And then Brian was the on camera reporter covering the events. So they took her first name Janice and his last name Mosher, to make Janice Mosher. The screech in was also at the Legion, which is the bar they go to in the musical. It is the bar where they actually got screeched in. It is also where a lot of the plane people were held. And so, like in the corner was the table where Hannah sat by the phone waiting for news about her son. And it was actually commemorated in her honor, which I thought was so sweet. And Beulah was also there working, so got to meet her. But it was just so cool to experience not only a screech in, but in the actual location where it took place and with the actual people that it took place with. It was just magical. And then today we spent the morning being driven around by the real life Oz Fudge. We went to the Dover Falls where Nick and Diane fell in love. There's even a little bench there dedicated to them. And apparently they are still together and just as in love as ever. And that just makes me so happy. We also stopped by the Gander Town Hall, saw the commemorated piece of steel from the World Trade Centre. And then we Just came back and had dinner and I'm about to head out to a drag show because apparently it's Gander pride right now, which is so fun. So very curious what a Gander pride show is like. It's just been the most magical trip so far. As a lot of you probably know, I'm here with Ashley Hufford, another content creator on here. And then we're also here with Emersyn Hunt and her family. She was the Jimmy Awards finalist this year, and if you watch the Jimmy Awards, you actually saw her as Beverly Bass, so it's been really cool to get to know them. They're all theatre people as well, so we're just a bunch of theatre people geeking out every step of the way. It's amazing and I can't wait to see what the rest of the trip has in store.
classificationReason: Mid-trip vlog update from Gander — meeting the real Claude (former mayor), attending screech-in ceremony. Come From Away is not on the approved show list; no listed production is discussed.
